description: Creates or recalls the run of a dftracer pipeline and returns a validated run_id and workspace; never runs pipeline stages.
instructions: Use pipeline_get_run_id(app) to find the active run; if there is none, pipeline_create_run(app, description). Validate the result with dftracer_pipeline_run_check(result, app, check_files=True) and repair per the skill's Corrector. Return run_id, app_name and workspace only.
